source_row.stem: A hospital publicly reports its nurse-sensitive quality indicator data, such as fall and pressure injury rates. This transparency is intended to:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Support informed patient/consumer decision-making and drive internal accountability for quality improvement","B":"Intended to apply only to for-profit hospitals, with no expectation of similar reporting elsewhere","C":"Considered to offer little practical benefit to either patients choosing care or the public at large","D":"Intended to fully replace a hospital's own internal quality improvement efforts going forward"}}
source_row.rationale: Public reporting of nurse-sensitive quality indicators supports informed patient and consumer decision-making while driving internal accountability and motivation for ongoing quality improvement.
source_row.source_name: ANA — Nurse-Sensitive Quality Indicator Public Reporting
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Public Quality Data Reporting
